### webgl2/program.js
WebGL2 shader compile + program link with readable, source-annotated errors.
annotateShaderLog is pure string processing (unit-tested); the rest needs a
WebGL2RenderingContext.

Types: ProgramOptions = { label?: string; attribLocations?: Record<string, number> }
Exports:
  annotateShaderLog(source, infoLog, contextLines? = 1) → string
    Interleaves "ERROR: 0:<line>:" style log lines with the referenced source
    lines (marker on the offending line, contextLines around it); log lines
    without a line reference pass through verbatim.
  compileShader(gl, type, source, label?) → WebGLShader
    Throws an Error containing the annotated info log on compile failure.
  createProgram(gl, vertexSource, fragmentSource, options?) → WebGLProgram
    Compile + link; binds attribLocations before linking (pin locations so VAOs
    need no program query); detaches/deletes shaders; throws annotated errors.
  getUniformLocations(gl, program, names) → Record<name, WebGLUniformLocation | null>
    Batch getUniformLocation; optimized-away/typo'd names map to null.

### webgl2/mesh.js
VAO construction from typed arrays: one ARRAY_BUFFER per attribute (packed
floats), optional index buffer with automatic 16/32-bit sizing.
chooseIndexArray is pure (unit-tested); createMesh needs a context.

Types: MeshAttribute = { location: number; data: Float32Array; size: number };
  MeshOptions = { mode? (default gl.TRIANGLES); indices?: ArrayLike<number> | Uint16Array | Uint32Array };
  Mesh = { vao, count, indexType (0 when non-indexed), mode, draw(): void, dispose(): void }.
Exports:
  chooseIndexArray(indices, vertexCount) → Uint16Array | Uint32Array
    Uint16 while vertexCount ≤ 65536, else Uint32; typed inputs pass through.
  createMesh(gl, attributes, options?) → Mesh
    Vertex count from the first attribute (data.length / size); draw() binds
    the VAO and issues drawElements/drawArrays, then unbinds.

### webgl2/fbo.js
Float-color framebuffer (RGBA16F default) for additive/HDR accumulation
without 8-bit clamping. Performs the EXT_color_buffer_float availability
check and the completeness check, throwing informative errors. No node unit
tests (needs a GL context).

Types: FloatFboOptions = { internalFormat?: 'rgba16f' | 'rgba32f'; filter? (default gl.LINEAR) };
  FloatFbo = { framebuffer, texture, width, height, resize(w, h): void, dispose(): void }.
Exports:
  createFloatFbo(gl, width, height, options?) → FloatFbo
    No depth attachment; resize() reallocates the backing texture;
    readPixels(..., gl.FLOAT, ...) works while the FBO is bound.

### webgl2/video-texture.js
Texture tracking an HTMLVideoElement (three.js VideoTexture equivalent).
Uses requestVideoFrameCallback when available to skip redundant uploads;
otherwise uploads on every update() with data. No node unit tests (needs
DOM + GL).

Types: VideoTextureOptions = { srgb? = true (SRGB8_ALPHA8 → linear samples;
  false = raw RGBA8 for data video); flipY? = true };
  VideoTexture = { texture, video, update(): boolean, dispose(): void }.
Exports:
  createVideoTexture(gl, video, options?) → VideoTexture
    LINEAR/CLAMP_TO_EDGE; allocates on first update() with data
    (readyState ≥ HAVE_CURRENT_DATA), texSubImage2D afterwards, reallocating
    if the video dimensions change; update() returns true when it uploaded.

### webgl2/fullscreen.js
Fullscreen triangle pass generated from gl_VertexID — no vertex buffer. The
GLSL lives in webgl2/shaders/fullscreen.vert.glsl and is embedded at build
time. No node unit tests (needs a GL context; the .glsl import needs the
build's text loader).

Exports:
  FULLSCREEN_VERTEX_SHADER: string
    #version 300 es vertex shader; emits `out vec2 vUv` in [0,1]² with v=0 at
    the bottom of the screen (pairs with flipY-uploaded textures).
  createFullscreenPass(gl) → { draw(): void, dispose(): void }
    draw() binds a dedicated empty VAO and drawArrays 3 vertices; bind your
    program/uniforms/blend state first.
